title: Held batch staging input older than 21 days

annotations.summary: A held input in batch staging is older than 21 days; deletion remains at day 30.
annotations.user_impact: The only server input may expire before transcription or assignment recovers.
annotations.scope: GPU-quarantined and assignment-held jobs whose audio_uri is in gs://based-hardware-batch-pipeline-staging. All epochs; audio_staged_at tracks the current replacement object, else enqueued_at proxies creation at admission. No GCS metadata read.
annotations.verification: Require a fresh timeliness sample. Compare job audio_staged_at when present, else enqueued_at; quarantine/commit/deadline timestamps do not reset object age. Missing or stale data is unknown; use the existing sampler-stale alert.
annotations.safe_next_action: Run the manual digest-approved held-input redrive dry-run, review aggregate results, and obtain scoped apply authorization. No lifecycle changes or automatic repair.
annotations.evaluated_bad: Synthetic staged-input age 1814401s with a sample younger than 900s, sustained 10m.
annotations.evaluated_good: Synthetic age at or below 1814400s; fresh zero when no held staging inputs remain.
